# Danny Deepak · Revenue Casebook

> Before I spend a rupee, I find where the last one leaked. Daniel Deepak (Danny) is a revenue growth consultant in Bengaluru, India. Seven case studies, each traced from first search to the till. Every figure is labelled Measured, Calculated, Estimate or Not available.

## Cases

- [TONI&GUY Bangalore](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/toni-and-guy.html): Premium salon, Bengaluru. 28 Feb – 16 Sep 2026. Role: Growth consultant: Google, Meta, web, booking app, reporting. Leak: Leads hit record volume; ticket size fell and no callback loop existed. Headline: +14.7% salon revenue, Mar–Aug 2026 vs 2025 (₹14.04 → ₹16.10 Cr). Evidence grade A.
- [MR Jewels](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/mr-jewels.html): Jewellery D2C, Bengaluru. 1 Aug – 3 Sep 2026. Role: Google Ads lead + full business review. Leak: Google claimed 11.8× real revenue; the losses sat in the cart and returns. Headline: −66% showroom cost per click after one conversion-goal fix (₹38.60 → ₹13.13). Evidence grade A.
- [Elites Dental Care](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/elites-dental.html): Dental clinic, TC Palya, Bengaluru. Audit 18 Sep 2026 · rebuild from 27 Sep. Role: Audit, Business Profile rebuild, Search rebuild. Leak: ₹3,140 per booking: the clicks were fine, everything after the click was broken. Headline: ₹3,140 per booking before the rebuild: ₹25,122 for 8 bookings. Evidence grade B.
- [Gold Coins Club & Resort](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/resort.html): Resort & events, Electronic City, Bengaluru. Audit 25 Sep – 1 Oct 2026 · engagement from 28 Sep. Role: Revenue audit, Business Profile, marketing + sales dashboard. Leak: Ad spend rose 3.2× in a quarter and bookings fell 13%: the leak sits between enquiry and booking. Headline: 24% → 14% enquiry-to-booking conversion, Q2 to Q3 2026. Evidence grade B.
- [Foremost Public Adjusters](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/foremost-pa.html): Insurance claims, South Florida. Jan – Jul 2026. Role: Paid search audit, SEO fixes, campaign build, brand investigation. Leak: Lead cost swung on post-click conversion, not budget, and the brand vanished. Headline: 0 / 247 live keywords that were branded: the brand campaign was paused in a restructure. Evidence grade B.
- [EveryWatch](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/everywatch.html): Luxury-watch marketplace, Global, remote. 2024 – 2025. Role: Growth & performance lead (in-house). Leak: Acquisition scaled; returning users stayed near one in ten. Headline: 20× monthly new users, Jan 2024 (9,113) → May 2025 (182,782), GA4. Evidence grade C.
- [Swift Restoration](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/swift-restoration.html): Emergency restoration, Boone, Iowa. June 2026. Role: Audit and execution plan. Leak: A 5.0★ operator with no service pages, no location pages and no Local Services Ads. Headline: 0 service or location pages on the site. Service cards linked to "#".. Evidence grade D.
